description: Allegany County Transit Stops is a dataset listed in State of Maryland open data portal (opendata.maryland.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Maryland. Layer of Allegany County Transit bus stops. ACT's system is a flag bus route system so not all of the stops have physical posts. Stops were retrieved from GTFS file. Coverage: Maryland. Its tags are county transit, allegany county, transit bus, stops act, posts stops. The table has 6 columns. The portal shows 2025-07-22 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-opendata-maryland-gov-portal.
